notes.title: Tails Noir: Rebel Rush day two patch update notes
notes.notes:
update notes for build v. 3.2.3


 more reliable himbos! fixed a glitchy himbo behavior when they pulled the car to the side
 fewer road bumps! fixed road stitches causing car to get stuck
 better dialogues! fixed rare issues with font displays
 quality of life improvements! now in "rebel rush" mode music changes depending on the chapter of the game


no changes in levels or level layouts, nothing that can affect leaderboard scores

hope you're having fun!!
dima,
soup with friends

notes.title: Tails Noir: Rebel Rush day one patch update notes
notes.notes:
update notes for build v. 3.1.1


 added mouse input: use left click for jump and right click for himbos
 fixed a weird bug with options screen getting stuck
 fixed a surreal bug with himbo usage in pause menu
 fixed a eerie behavior in a dialogue display order


no changes in levels or level layouts, nothing that can affect leaderboard scores

thanks for all the kind words and steam reviews!
dima,
soup with friends

notes.title: Tails Noir: Rebel Rush demo v1.2.0 update notes
notes.notes:
update notes


 level 1 layout update: smoother curve for a jump before science world. better experience for new players, affects speedrun scores
 UI: levels names are added to the leaderboard cards
 updated HUD icons to fit better
 minor fixes under the hood


buckle up, we're going to make it through
dima,
soup with friends

notes.title: Tails Noir: Rebel Rush, demo v1.1.0 update
notes.notes:
check out our first update to the demo!

 more handrails on a tutorial level
 communication improvements on lvl2
 ui contrast improvements
 tiny iu fixes

nothing that should affect speedrunning scores (as far as I am aware)

if you notice any issues with the game or have any ideas or feedback, make sure to drop us a line at our discord: https://discord.com/invite/tailsnoir

 
enjoy and have an exciting day,
dima,
soup with friends
